title: Consolidate AgentRunTools into ChatsTools
description:
`src/agentRun/AgentRunTools.ts` and `src/agentRun/agentRunTypes.ts` are obsolete. The functionality for isolated agent runs should be handled by `ChatsTools` using the `AGENT_RUN` chat context.

Refactor `src/orchestrator.ts` to use `ChatsTools` (and `AGENT_RUN` / `AGENT_RUN_FEATURE` contexts) instead of `AgentRunTools`, then remove the obsolete `src/agentRun/` module.

## New relevant context (from story: Two-phase completions / completion helpers)
### Completion orchestration should be ChatsTools-first
We now have a strong base helper in `src/completion/completionHelpers.ts`:
- `createCompletionWithToolsParams({ chatsTools, request, settings, callTool, llmCostsTools? })`
  - wires `toolsReceivedCallback` to persist assistant + placeholder tool messages via `chatsTools.addChatMessages`
  - wires `toolCalledCallback` to update the correct tool message by `toolCallId`
  - wires `responseReceivedCallback` to persist the assistant message and apply `dynamicContextPatch` via `chatsTools.updateDynamicContext`
  - wires `getDynamicContext` to load `chat.dynamicContext` via `chatsTools.getChat`
  - wires `onFinishCallback` to record system error/max-turns messages

**Orchestrator refactor direction**: instantiate `ChatsTools` (e.g. via `createChatsTools(projectRoot)`) and build `sendCompletionWithTools(...)` params using `createCompletionWithToolsParams` rather than ad-hoc callback plumbing.

### Removal of AgentRun logging as part of migration
Current orchestrator still logs messages to `AgentRunTools` conversations and currently may stub `getDynamicContext` instead of loading from chat.
During migration, prefer using chat persistence as the canonical log:
- assistant messages
- tool call placeholders + results
- dynamic context updates

### Resumability requirement (tool confirmation flow)
Completion is gaining a `resumeCompletionTools` capability (see story 36ce4268... Feature 3) so clients can resume tool loops after confirmation-required tools have been resolved.
This is directly relevant to orchestrator migration: orchestration should be able to restart/resume a run purely from persisted chat history (no AgentRun conversation state required).

### Testing considerations
Orchestrator tests (`src/orchestrator.test.ts`) currently depend on `AgentRunTools` mocks. Migrating to ChatsTools will require new tests to assert:
- chat messages persisted correctly (assistant + tool messages)
- tool message state transitions (`require_confirmation` -> running -> success/errored)
- dynamicContextPatch is persisted via `ChatsTools.updateDynamicContext`

## Key requirements for `ChatsTools` to fully replace the remaining `AgentRunTools` needs
- Efficient listing of chats by type and scope (avoid scanning all chats): `listChatsByType(type, projectId, storyId?, featureId?)`.
- Generic metadata updates with merge semantics: `updateChatMetadata(context, patch)`.
- Rating support: `rateChat(context, { score, comment? })` setting `createdAt` automatically.
- Basic in-process concurrency safety within a single `ChatsTools` instance (per-chat lock) to avoid lost updates during concurrent read/modify/write operations.

Non-requirements (explicitly out of scope):
- `getRun` / `deleteRun` wrappers
- run-specific file watchers (we already watch chats)
- `statusMessage`, `startedAt`, `finishedAt` (derive from `createdAt` / `updatedAt`)
- persisting LLM config / secrets (model/provider details are stored on messages)

features.title: Migrate AgentRun Types and Logic to ChatsTools
features.description:
Implement the remaining functionality needed to retire `AgentRunTools` by extending `src/chats/ChatsTools.ts` and `src/chats/chatsTypes.ts`.

### Scope
Add the following APIs to `ChatsTools`:
1) `listChatsByType(type, projectId, storyId?, featureId?)`
   - Must narrow filesystem traversal to the smallest subtree based on the provided scope (project/story/feature) and then filter by `context.type`.
   - Purpose: support listing agent runs without scanning all chats.

2) `updateChatMetadata(context, patch)`
   - Generic metadata updater; `metadata` is treated as an untyped object.
   - Must merge into `chat.metadata` (do not overwrite by default).

3) `rateChat(context, { score, comment? })`
   - Persists `chat.rating` with `rating.createdAt` set automatically.

4) Basic concurrency safety (single instance)
   - Add a simple in-process per-chat lock (keyed by chat path/context key) so that concurrent writes from the same `ChatsTools` instance do not lose updates.
   - Cross-process / multi-instance locking is out of scope.

### Notes
- No need for run wrappers (`getRun`, `deleteRun`) or run watchers.
- No need for `statusMessage`, `startedAt`, `finishedAt`.
- No need to persist LLM config/secrets; message-level provider/model info is sufficient.

### (Optional) small fix in same area
- Fix the incorrect error message in `updateChatSettings` / `updateCompletionSettings` where it references `selector.type` (selector is undefined).

features.title: Refactor Orchestrator to use ChatsTools
features.description: Update `src/orchestrator.ts` to replace usage of `AgentRunTools` with `ChatsTools`. The orchestrator currently uses `agentRunTools.createRun`, `startConversation`, `addMessagesToConversation`, etc. These calls should be replaced with `chatsTools.createChat` (or `getChat`), `addChatMessages`, and updating the chat state. The `runId` concept maps to `agentRunId` in `ChatContextAgentRun`.

features.title: Remove Obsolete AgentRun Module
features.description: Once the orchestrator is refactored and tests pass, delete the `src/agentRun/` directory and remove references to `AgentRunTools` from `src/index.ts` and other files. Update `docs/FILE_ORGANISATION.md` to reflect the removal.
